overview.description: The Vanguard High Dividend Yield Index ETF (VYM) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the FTSE Custom High Dividend Yield index. The fund tracks an index of high dividend-paying US companies. Holdings are weighted by market cap. VYM was launched on Nov 10, 2006 and is issued by Vanguard.
